item.description: 📢 📢 4th call of the EUDIS Business Accelerator open for applicants! The EUDIS Business Accelerator programme supports European start-ups and scale-ups looking to strengthen their market readiness and build the right connections across the European defence ecosystem. The three main tech themes for this call will be the following: - Autonomous Systems & Robotics for Operational Advantage - Counter-Drone & Protection Against Mass Low-Cost Threats - Production, Sustainment and Logistics 20 selected companies will be granted access to an 8-month programme including on-site bootcamps across Europe, tailored coaching and training, access to testing facilities and technical expertise, and a €120,000 funding voucher. Applicants are asked to fill in the online application form, provide an evaluation deck and a video pitch presentation. The call is open until 16 November 2026, an online webinar will be organized on 29 October 2026. ➡️ More information on the programme, presentation webinar and applications: https://lnkd.in/e2hcwMZR Starburst Community, Starburst, Civitta, Ignity, VTT Hellenic Centre for Defence Innovation S.A., Estonian Defence and Aerospace Industry Association, Luxinnovation GIE, Léo B. item.title: 📢 3rd EDF NFP training organized by EOA partner Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster! EDF NFPs gathered las...
item.description: 📢 3rd EDF NFP training organized by EOA partner Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster! EDF NFPs gathered last week in Zadar (HR) for a 2-day training workshop organized under the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All project by CDICC. In order to best seize their role of NFP and understand how to approach different scenarios with different potential EDF applicants, a series of lectures were given on Day 1 by Aleš Lipnik (Doit-R Solutions), allowing participants to learn and share best practices based on proven experience. EDF and NATO DIANA laureates were also invited to take the floor and present selected EDF projects along with challenges and lessons learned. Hrvoje Basic from Amphinicy Technologies Ltd., and the Project “European Protected Waveform (Phase 2)”, (EDF 2024) Mario Colnar from Indeloop Ltd. And the Project “Sentinel”, (EDF 2024) Ive Botunac from ALFATEC Group. And the Project “LODESTAR II", (EDF 2024) Davorin Ambrus from InEMsens | NATO DIANA Innovator Ltd. And the Project “Advanced Electromagnetic Sensor Technology for Dual-Use Detection”, (NATO DIANA) On Day 2, participating NFPs received an overview of the current operational readiness within the EU from Zvonko Orehovec, M.Sc (Res), PhD, enlightening on the R&D and operational challenges of technologies on the battlefields. The programme continued with the presentation of the NFP Guiding Manual by Grubesic Bruno from HKKOI, and was concluded by a twinning arrangement with Anja Klauzer from FFG Österreichische Forschungsförderungsgesellschaft mbH. Through this valuable workshop EDF NFPs are offered the opportunity to improve their knowledge of each national defence innovation ecosystem and build a more unified and resilient NFP network. item.description: 📌 Mark your calendar: ENDR Conference “From Lab to Field: Deep Tech Dual-Use Innovation for Defence”, on 25 - 26 November in Eindhoven In the framework of the The European Network of Defence-related Regions, in collaboration with the Brabant Development Agency (BOM),Brainport Development and the Dutch Ministry of Defence (the Defence Innovation Team North Brabant) the DG DEFIS together with Province of North Brabant will host the ENDR conference “From Lab to Field: Deep Tech Dual-Use Innovation for Defence” 🔎 The event will serve as a platform to discuss, demonstrate, and scale cooperation models between high-tech and deep-tech ecosystems with defence and security applications. Enabling technologies such as integrated photonics, wireless optical communication, autonomous systems (including C-UAS), sensing, quantum systems, and European and national dual-use funding programs will be on the agenda. 📍On Day 1, attend keynotes, interactive workshops, exhibition & networking dinner and matchmaking opportunities. 📍On Day 2, deep dive into North Brabant's innovation ecosystem with site visits and field trips around Eindhoven. ➡️ Further details on the agenda and registration will follow. item.description: 📌 Save the Date: ENDR Conference ”European Young Professionals Defence Summit 2026” in Malmö on 27 – 28 October 2026 In the framework of the European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Säkerhets- och försvarsföretagen (SOFF) - will host the ENDR conference “European Young Professionals Defence Summit”. Over two days in Malmö, participants will engage with leading experts and decision-makers through keynote speeches, panel discussions, interactive sessions, and networking activities. Discussions will address Europe's changing security environment, the defence market and industrial growth, skills development and workforce needs, and the relationship between technology, innovation, and operational effect. 👉 Further details on the agenda, confirmed speakers and registration on the dedicated webpage: https://lnkd.in/ezPNPPyM. item.title: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC...
item.description: 📢 Defence and dual-use technologies become eligible to EIC funding instruments ▶️ As a result of an amendment to the EIC work programme 2026 adopted on 17 June 2026 by the Commission to implement the Defence Mini-Omnibus, the EIC Accelerator and STEP Scaleup will from now on support companies developing dual-use technologies. Start-ups and SMEs developing technologies with a focus on dual-use business cases, both civilian and defence applications, can apply for grants up to €2.5 million and equity investments up to €30 million. ▶️ At the same time, the EIC is launching a new €100 million EIC STEP Defence Scale Up call, allowing companies in the EU Member States and countries associated to Horizon Europe to receive up to €30 million in direct equity financing in sectors such as air and missile defence, drones and counter drones, and other critical defence technologies. 🔎 This is the first time any EU funding programme will ever invest direct equity in defence companies. They can apply from 30 June until 28 October 2026, and the results are expected in early 2027. 👉 More information on the dedicated news article: https://lnkd.in/egVPTANM Léo B. item.title: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual w...
item.description: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual work programme under the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), a new EU initiative meant to strengthen and modernise Europe’s defence industry, ramp-up production capacity and secure Europe’s technological edge and resilience. 📍Over EUR 700 million of EDIP are dedicated to reinforcing European defence production. European companies can apply to receive funding for Industrial Reinforcement Actions (IRA) and increase their manufacturing capacities for energetic components, key electronic components, and defence platforms and end-products. Two additional calls dedicated to Ukraine (USI-IRA) aim at reinforcing Ukrainian defence industrial production capacity in terms of missiles, ammunition and bombs and (counter-)drone systems. 📍 Funding rates for successful projects are between 35-100% of eligible project costs, depending on the respective call. First calls will open on 30 April and the very first call on energetic components will already close mid-June. ➡️ More details on the new EDIP webpage (tutorial videos, factsheets, timelines, application process) => https://lnkd.in/ePQrbrWG Léo B. item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. item.description: 🚨🚨 EDF Work Programme 2026 released! 🚨🚨 Today, the EDF Work Programme 2026 was adopted by the Commission. All work programme files are available on DEFIS’ website: https://lnkd.in/efjYmBqp. item.title: 📰 Ukraine officially associated to EDF as part of the EU-Ukraine Defence Industrial Partnership! 📌 On 15th July, the Eur...
item.description: 📰 Ukraine officially associated to EDF as part of the EU-Ukraine Defence Industrial Partnership! 📌 On 15th July, the European Commission and Ukraine signed a new defence industrial partnership, enabling Ukrainian and EU companies to accelerate the development of critical defence capabilities, to strengthen joint industrial production and to work together on EU-funded defence research and development. Ukraine has indeed been fully associated to both the European Defence Fund (EDF) and the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), enabling Ukrainian and EU companies to form consortia and participate together in collaborative defence research and development projects supported by the Fund. The Commission also launched the EU–Ukraine Drone Deal to deepen cooperation on drone and counter-drone technologies. Finally, the Commission disbursed a further €1 billion to support Ukraine's drone capabilities under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. 🔎 More information and quotes in the official press release: https://lnkd.in/gtzbke3E ( 📷 copyrigth picture: Martin Joasaar) Léo B.
